lines.text: The LORD reveals Himself to those who did not ask and holds out His hands to a people following their own imaginations.
These people provoke the LORD by sacrificing in the gardens, sitting among the graves, and eating the meat of pigs.
The LORD will repay them in full because they burned incense on the mountains and scorned Him on the hills.
The LORD will bring forth descendants from Jacob and heirs from Benjamin, and the Valley of Achor will be a resting place for herds.
Those who forsake the LORD set a table for Baal and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny, so the sword awaits them.
